document.about: Federal Reserve Monetary Policy Report, July 2024. Its charts stand in a column beside the text, each with a scale of numbers set level with its axis's ticks, lined up with the lines of the paragraph beside it.

notes: 2026-11-28 (a second producer): a chart's category labels read with spaces inside their words (`Disabilit y`, `Wage quartil es`, `Ra ce`), from spaces drawn out of turn between letters that close up.
